facts.fact: Malawi's Ministry of Education (DSTI) tracer study of 2022 tertiary graduates reports 30.1% graduated in STEM degree programmes, from 16,735 graduates who provided data.
facts.system: Malawi Tracer Study of Graduates from HEIs

facts.fact: The Ministry of Education's DSTI says the Malawi Research and Education Network (MAREN) was established by public universities to provide connectivity and value-added services for the research and education sectors, and it has hosted the national HPC facility since June 2022.
